decisions.reason: As a coolant-handling product squarely within our established engineering and service knowledge, it fits our absorptive capacity well and merits another year to scale and refine in a growing machinery market.

The coolant cleaning centrifuge builds directly on our existing process-media and filtration capabilities, so our in-house R&D and application knowledge make it sensible to retain and improve commercially.
Coolant nozzles are a closely related extension of our coolant-management offering and strengthen system-level customer value, which we are well positioned to learn from and integrate.

The scraper belt chip conveyor is close to our automation and material-flow base, and keeping it supports portfolio breadth and customer-specific system solutions that a large German machinery firm can exploit.
The magnetic belt chip conveyor clearly builds on our established conveyor expertise, so our related knowledge and service network should allow continued commercial learning and improvement.

The hinged belt chip conveyor is adjacent to our core conveying business and should be kept because our existing design, production and after-sales capabilities reduce the risk of further development.
